questions.text: What do you mean by planning and organization in functional areas of management?
questions.text_as_printed: What do you mean by planning and organization in functional areas of management? (D)

answer.value:
Planning
Planning means deciding future activities in advance for a specific period. The planning process includes determination of objectives, policies, strategies, programs, procedures, and schedules for achieving the goals of the organization.
Organization:
Organization means bringing together human resources and physical resources. Combining machinery and equipment resources with human resources and engaging them in work to achieve the objectives of the organization is the main aim of organization.
